source_clause: NOPR3.1) If vehicle is not equipped with connectivity, pressing “Get Started” will show PU0585 and will not show Connected Account Login/Register Screen.
leaf_desc_037: NOPR3.1) If vehicle is not equipped with connectivity, pressing “Get Started” will show PU0585 and will not show Connected Account Login/Register Screen.
reasoning: 驗證目標：6.4.1（NOPR3.1）—— 無連網配置之車輛按下 Get Started 時顯示 PU0585，且不顯示 Connected Account 之登入／註冊畫面。關鍵情境條件：車輛配置（無連網）為條件本身，故列 pre-condition；正反兩個觀察點（顯示 PU0585／不顯示登入畫面）為同一觸發之兩個結果，併為兩條 ER。為什麼這樣切：有連網之對應行為屬 6.4 之另一 leaf，本 TC 不代測，亦不自行擴充為配置對照組。

tcs.tc_title: PU0585 shown on Get Started without vehicle connectivity
tcs.test_item: PU0585 shown on Get Started without vehicle connectivity
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is not equipped with connectivity
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Profile setup screen carrying the “Get Started” button
2. Press “Get Started” and check that PU0585 is displayed and the Connected Account Login/Register screen is not displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The “Get Started” button is displayed
2. PU0585 is displayed and the Connected Account Login/Register screen is not displayed
tcs.priority_basis: setup flow 之非主路徑分支（無連網配置）
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
